diffs.diff: shunt voltage (mV), raw = register>>3 signed: datasheet reading gives 0.04 per count, the part's model has 0.8, 0.008, 0.8, 0.008, 0.8, 0.008
diffs.evidence: TI INA3221 datasheet, Shunt-Voltage registers 01h/03h/05h: 'Full-scale range = 163.8mV (decimal = 7FF8); LSB (SD0): 40μV' (= 0.04 mV per count, matching the driver's shunt_mv() which multiplies (raw>>3) by 0.04). The model's 0.8 scales on 01h/03h/05h are the same LSB expressed as load current: 0.04 mV / 0.05 Ω = 0.8 mA per count, with the Adafruit #6062 board's 'built-in 0.05 ohm, 1% sense resistors' (Adafruit guide); those measures drive the current1/2/3 controls in mA. The 0.008 scales are the bus-voltage registers 02h/04h/06h ('LSB (BD0) = 8mV'), a different quantity that the second reading also lists as 0.008 V per count. Equivalent units, no error.
